name: run-length
description: Run-length encoding (RLE) for compressing repetitive sequences in strings and arrays, with string-specific convenience functions.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when compressing data with long runs of repeated values, such as simple bitmap images, sparse arrays, or repeated-character text strings. Provides both generic array/string RLE and a text-specific variant.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The string or array to encode using run-length encoding.

parameters.name: encoded
parameters.description: The run-length encoded output to decode back to the original format.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: A plain string for text-specific encode/decode variants.
